test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Mr. Das, my friend / and Principal / of this college, / have retired.
solution: The erroneous part is **'have retired'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'has retired' **should be used instead of** 'have retired'.** • We know that the **helping verb** of a sentence should be according to its main **subject**. • In the given sentence the main subject is **'Mr. Das' **which is **singular**. • Hence, **a singular helping verb** (has) should be used. ​**Correct Sentence:__** *Mr. Das, my friend and Principal of this college, has retired.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'have retired' **के स्थान पर** 'has retired' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि किसी वाक्य की **helping verb** उसके **main subject** के अनुसार होनी चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में मुख्य विषय **'Mr. Das'** जो **singular** है। • इसलिए, एक **singular helping verb** (has) का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। 102:T1203, The correct answer is **Father said to the children, “There is some good news for you today.”**
